task: pick up the tomato sauce and place it in the basket

windows.text: Reach the open gripper toward the tomato sauce bottle on the table.
Reach the open gripper toward the tomato sauce bottle on the table.
Reach the open gripper horizontally toward the tomato sauce bottle.
Approach the tomato sauce bottle from above, lowering the open gripper toward its neck.
Approach the tomato sauce can from above, lowering the open gripper around it.
Grasp the tomato sauce can by closing the gripper fingers around its sides.
Lift the tomato sauce can up off the floor, raising it above the surrounding cartons.
Lift the tomato sauce can vertically off the floor, raising it above the surrounding objects.
Carry the tomato sauce can horizontally across the table toward the basket.
Carry the tomato sauce can horizontally toward the basket.
Carry the tomato sauce can over the basket.
Lower the tomato sauce can down into the basket.
Release the tomato sauce can into the basket and open the gripper fingers.
